ExoTETHyS coefficients via pylightcurve 4.0.4
 exotethys(); see the header of test/make_ld_reference.py

anchor.note: exotethys(logg, teff, feh, 'TESS', method='claret', stellar_model='phoenix'); pylightcurve resets [Fe/H] to 0 for PHOENIX, so the published numbers are for solar metallicity. With log g 4.4 the current pylightcurve data reproduce them to 1.2e-4 (pylightcurve_now).
